name: Tar-Baphon's Whisper
text: You have learned the secrets of sotto voce, the eerie, dry whispering voice used to pass on cult secrets. You may cast sotto voce (page 61) as a spell-like ability three times per day as a spell-like ability. This spell-like ability is cast at your highest caster level; if you have no caster level, it functions at CL 1st.
